sloka: शूर भार्याम् हताम् पश्य सद्यो माम् विधवाम् कृताम् ।अवभग्नः च मे मानो भग्ना मे शाश्वती गतिः ॥४-२३-९॥
transliteration: śūra bhāryām hatām paśya sadyo mām vidhavām kṛtām ।avabhagnaḥ ca me māno bhagnā me śāśvatī gatiḥ ॥4-23-9॥

translations.english: 'My pride is crushed. My husband, the ultimate resort for me is shattered.I am plunged in a vast, bottomless ocean of grief.
